public_surface_policy.corrections: Corrections and source comparisons can be proposed through GitHub issues or pull requests.
public_surface_policy.legacy_filename_warning: Older filenames containing Complete, Source-Checked, or Critical are not global certification claims.
public_surface_policy.classification: Substantive source-aware working editions and translations; not complete SGA, not independently human-certified, not whole-volume source certification, and not critical editions.

workflow_lessons: Use high-quality source scans and page slices as direct witnesses for repair sessions.
Use OCR and rendered crops as locator/check layers, not as source authority.
Freeze source units, TeX, PDF, ledgers, hashes, build evidence, and targeted visual QA together before publication.
Keep French/source branches and translation branches explicitly separated when synchronization is incomplete.
Publish coherent bounded checkpoints promptly, while preserving exact scope and caveats.
